name: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
summary: Antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care, plus gynaecological presentations. Sensitive history taking and consent are central.
recommendations: Practise a structured obstetric history and summarise it as 'G_P_ at _ weeks'.
Ask patients for permission explicitly before observing; thank them afterwards.
Link maternal conditions to neonatal outcomes (this connects with your paediatric learning).
